name: cta-giant-link
title: Giant link CTA
description: The ask as one enormous line of type that is itself the link, with an email and a short note beneath, for studios and freelancers.
docs: Pass label (the line, such as Let's work together) and href (where it goes), and under it optionally email, note (how fast you reply) and availability (the next free slot). The whole line is the link and sits between two hairlines in a heading. Its size follows the width of the section, not the screen, so it fits a narrow column as well as a wide page, and it breaks only between words, with the arrow kept to the last one so it never sits alone on a row. Hover softens the colour and moves the arrow up and to the right, and so does keyboard focus, which also draws a ring around the whole line; nothing else moves, and reduced motion removes the arrow's travel. The address is a mailto link with a Copy button that turns to Copied in words, tells a screen reader, and says so beside the button when the browser refuses. Only the copy button is a client component, so the section itself renders on the server. labels translates the names of the details and the copy button.
